policy: Only stock MajorMUD behavior is scored. Reforged-only convenience services remain available outside Classic but do not count toward MajorMUD parity.

give.finding: Official command help exposes GIVE as the direct player-to-player item transfer command.

receive.finding: Official command help says RECEIVE controls whether other players can give items; SHARE help also excludes recipients whose RECEIVE is off.

auction.finding: Official help describes AUCTION as a gossip-like communication channel used to advertise trading/selling, not an escrow/accept transaction system.

shops.finding: The stock command help enumerates shop operations and does not expose REPAIR as a shop command.

operator_stock_observations.give: Players trade by giving directly; there is no separate stock TRADE accept/escrow workflow.
operator_stock_observations.encumbrance: GIVE fails when the recipient cannot take the incoming weight.
operator_stock_observations.limited_items: Limited status alone does not make an item ungiveable; special item restrictions may still block transfer.
operator_stock_observations.repair: No stock repair service is believed to exist.
operator_stock_observations.shop_failures: Stock purchase failures are fundamentally insufficient funds or unavailable stock.
operator_stock_observations.rug_12_2248: The move/pull rug opening is temporary and follows the normal MajorMUD door timer authority.

classic_give: checks recipient carried weight against the recovered Classic encumbrance capacity
runs RuntimeItemEngine.Give restrictions before cross-character commit
classic_extension_isolation: TRADE convenience command is blocked in Classic and retained only for non-Classic worlds
REPAIR generated service is blocked in Classic and retained only for non-Classic worlds
shop_boundary: BUY checks persistent stock before settling copper
currency debit is authoritative for insufficient-funds failure
runtime_closure.transport: MajorMUD ownership is accepted; exact records, schedule/fare/boarding/message semantics remain UNKNOWN.
runtime_closure.rug_12_2248: The final qualified-exit behavior family is no longer unknown: activation is temporary and shares the normal Classic door-timer authority. Exact duration and failure message remain unresolved under timer/message closure.
